steps.title: Book or Walk In
steps.text: Reserve online in a few taps or stop by anytime. Settle in, and let the day be yours.

steps.title: Sit Down & Consult
steps.text: We start by really listening to your hair, your routine, and the look you've been picturing.

steps.title: Relax Into the Chair
steps.text: Sink into a warm shampoo, then let your stylist work color, cut, or balayage at an easy pace.

steps.title: Leave Loving It
steps.text: We finish with styling tips and book your next visit, so your look stays fresh between appointments.

ritual.heading: Tu Visita, de Principio a Fin

steps.title: Reserva o Pásate
steps.text: Reserva en línea en unos toques o pásate cuando quieras. Acomódate y deja que el día sea tuyo.

steps.title: Siéntate y Consulta
steps.text: Empezamos por escuchar de verdad tu cabello, tu rutina y el look que has estado imaginando.

steps.title: Relájate en la Silla
steps.text: Disfruta un lavado tibio y deja que tu estilista trabaje color, corte o balayage a un ritmo tranquilo.

steps.title: Sal Enamorada
steps.text: Terminamos con consejos de peinado y reservamos tu próxima visita, para que tu look siga fresco entre citas.
